datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2014, classifying geographic areas into food insecurity phases. The spatial data represents post-assessment impact classifications of food insecurity conditions across Afghanistan, aggregated into quarterly snapshots (January, April, July, October).
